title: CSV to a report with totals and top products

turns.prompt: {D}/sales.csv has 500 orders (columns date, order_id, product, quantity, unit_price, revenue). Write {D}/report.md with: total revenue, the top 3 products by revenue (with their revenue), and revenue per month. Use two decimals. Then give me the total and the top 3.
turns.verify: f={D}/report.md; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no report.md; exit 0; }; sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f | head -50; echo PASS

rubric.criteria: Report is organised (sections for total, top 3 with amounts, per-month table), numbers have two decimals, nothing invented.
